    Lemma 12.7: nonresonant polynomials #

    deformation-refinements.tex (lem:nonresonant-polynomials): grade k[t_1, …, t_s] by deg t_i = χ_i in an abelian group L. If the χ_i are pairwise distinct and no χ_j is a sum ∑ n_i χ_i with n_i ≥ 0 and ∑ n_i ≥ 2, then a homogeneous polynomial of weight χ_j with zero constant term is a_j t_j.

    The remark after the lemma ("characters forming part of an integer basis of a lattice satisfy these hypotheses") is nonresonant_of_basis.
